# TwoPane

Header: `winui/ui/panes/TwoPane.hpp`. Spec: `winui/ui/panes/TwoPane.hpp`.

Two content panes that sit side by side when there is width, stacked when there is height, and collapse to one pane when there is neither.

Each measure pass picks the mode from the available size. It is Wide when the width exceeds [min_wide_mode_width()](#min_wide_mode_width), else Tall when the height exceeds [min_tall_mode_height()](#min_tall_mode_height), else a single pane chosen by [pane_priority()](#pane_priority). The two panes share the split axis by [pane1_length()](#pane1_length) and [pane2_length()](#pane2_length), like two [Grid](grid.md#uigrid) tracks. The pane not shown takes no part in layout, rendering, focus or accessibility. There is no mode-changed event, so read [mode()](#mode) after layout. Panes are not wrapped in a [Scroll](scroll.md#uiscroll), so put one in a pane that needs to scroll. Spanning two screens is not supported.

Example: 
```cpp
auto  view = std::make_unique<ui::TwoPaneControl>();
auto* list = view->set_pane1(std::make_unique<ui::ListViewControl>());
view->set_pane2(std::make_unique<ui::TextControl>("Select an item"));
view->set_pane1_length(ui::GridLength::dip(320.0f));
view->set_min_wide_mode_width(500.0f);
view->set_tall_mode_configuration(ui::TwoPaneTallModeConfiguration::SinglePane);
window.set_content(std::move(view));

// Or declaratively:
window.set_content(ui::TwoPane{
    .pane1_length        = ui::GridLength::dip(320.0f),
    .min_wide_mode_width = 500.0f,
    .pane1               = ui::Text{.text = "Master"},
    .pane2               = ui::Text{.text = "Detail"},
});
```

## `ui::TwoPane`

Two regions that sit side by side, stacked or alone, depending on the space they get. Builds a [ui::TwoPaneControl](#uitwopanecontrol). No event reports the mode. Read [TwoPaneControl::mode()](#mode) after layout.

Each measure picks the mode from the available size. It is Wide when the width exceeds [`min_wide_mode_width`](#uitwopane-min_wide_mode_width), else Tall when the height exceeds [`min_tall_mode_height`](#uitwopane-min_tall_mode_height), else the single pane [`pane_priority`](#uitwopane-pane_priority) names.

Example: 
```cpp
using ui::operator""_dip;

window.set_content(ui::TwoPane{
    .pane1_length        = 320_dip,
    .min_wide_mode_width = 500.0f,
    .pane1               = ui::ListView<std::string>{.items = {"Inbox", "Sent", "Drafts"}},
    .pane2               = ui::Text{.text = "Select an item"},
});
```

Every field, in the order a designated initializer names them:

```cpp
ui::TwoPane{
    .pane1_length, .pane2_length, .pane_priority, .wide_mode_configuration,
    .tall_mode_configuration, .min_wide_mode_width, .min_tall_mode_height, .style, .margin,
    .width, .height, .min_width, .min_height, .max_width, .max_height, .horizontal_alignment,
    .vertical_alignment, .visible, .tool_tip, .accessibility, .on_pointer_entered,
    .on_pointer_exited, .on_got_focus, .on_lost_focus, .on_key_down, .on_wheel, .control,
    .pane1, .pane2
}
```

## `ui::TwoPaneControl`

Derives from `ui::Element`.

Two content panes that sit side by side when there is width, stacked when there is height, and collapse to one pane when there is neither.

Each measure pass picks the mode from the available size. It is Wide when the width exceeds [min_wide_mode_width()](#min_wide_mode_width), else Tall when the height exceeds [min_tall_mode_height()](#min_tall_mode_height), else a single pane chosen by [pane_priority()](#pane_priority). The two panes share the split axis by [pane1_length()](#pane1_length) and [pane2_length()](#pane2_length), like two [Grid](grid.md#uigrid) tracks. The pane not shown takes no part in layout, rendering, focus or accessibility. There is no mode-changed event, so read [mode()](#mode) after layout. Panes are not wrapped in a [Scroll](scroll.md#uiscroll), so put one in a pane that needs to scroll. Spanning two screens is not supported.

Example: 
```cpp
auto  view = std::make_unique<ui::TwoPaneControl>();
auto* list = view->set_pane1(std::make_unique<ui::ListViewControl>());
view->set_pane2(std::make_unique<ui::TextControl>("Select an item"));
view->set_pane1_length(ui::GridLength::dip(320.0f));
view->set_min_wide_mode_width(500.0f);
view->set_tall_mode_configuration(ui::TwoPaneTallModeConfiguration::SinglePane);
window.set_content(std::move(view));

// Or declaratively:
window.set_content(ui::TwoPane{
    .pane1_length        = ui::GridLength::dip(320.0f),
    .min_wide_mode_width = 500.0f,
    .pane1               = ui::Text{.text = "Master"},
    .pane2               = ui::Text{.text = "Detail"},
});
```

### TwoPaneControl

```cpp
TwoPaneControl() = default
```

An empty view: no panes, pane 1 Auto, pane 2 one fraction, both thresholds 641 DIPs.

### set_pane1

```cpp
template <typename T>
T* set_pane1(std::unique_ptr<T> content)
```

Takes ownership of pane 1 and returns a non-owning observer, like [ExpanderControl::set_content()](expander.md#set_content). Destroys any previous pane 1. Null clears it. Lays the view out again.

### set_pane2

```cpp
template <typename T>
T* set_pane2(std::unique_ptr<T> content)
```

Takes ownership of pane 2 and returns a non-owning observer; see [set_pane1()](#set_pane1).

### pane1

```cpp
Element* pane1() const
```

Pane 1, or null before [set_pane1()](#set_pane1). Owned by the view.

### pane2

```cpp
Element* pane2() const
```

Pane 2, or null before [set_pane2()](#set_pane2). Owned by the view.

### pane1_length

```cpp
GridLength pane1_length() const
```

Pane 1's track along the split axis, a [GridLength](grid.md#struct-gridlength) as in a [Grid](grid.md#uigrid) track (DIPs, Auto or a fraction); Auto by default.

### set_pane1_length

```cpp
void set_pane1_length(GridLength length)
```

Changes pane 1's track and lays the view out again. Only used while both panes are shown.

### pane2_length

```cpp
GridLength pane2_length() const
```

Pane 2's track along the split axis; one fraction by default, so it takes the rest.

### set_pane2_length

```cpp
void set_pane2_length(GridLength length)
```

Changes pane 2's track and lays the view out again.

### pane_priority

```cpp
TwoPanePriority pane_priority() const
```

The pane shown in SinglePane mode; Pane1 by default.

### set_pane_priority

```cpp
void set_pane_priority(TwoPanePriority priority)
```

Changes the single-pane choice and lays the view out again.

### wide_mode_configuration

```cpp
TwoPaneWideModeConfiguration wide_mode_configuration() const
```

How the panes are arranged in Wide mode; LeftRight by default.

### set_wide_mode_configuration

```cpp
void set_wide_mode_configuration(TwoPaneWideModeConfiguration configuration)
```

Changes the Wide arrangement and lays the view out again.

### tall_mode_configuration

```cpp
TwoPaneTallModeConfiguration tall_mode_configuration() const
```

How the panes are arranged in Tall mode; TopBottom by default.

### set_tall_mode_configuration

```cpp
void set_tall_mode_configuration(TwoPaneTallModeConfiguration configuration)
```

Changes the Tall arrangement and lays the view out again.

### min_wide_mode_width

```cpp
float min_wide_mode_width() const
```

The width threshold in DIPs; 641 by default. Wide needs more available width than this. An unbounded width never qualifies.

### set_min_wide_mode_width

```cpp
void set_min_wide_mode_width(float width)
```

Sets the Wide threshold, clamped to >= 0, and lays the view out again.

### min_tall_mode_height

```cpp
float min_tall_mode_height() const
```

The height threshold in DIPs; 641 by default. Tall needs more available height than this. Only tested when Wide did not apply.

### set_min_tall_mode_height

```cpp
void set_min_tall_mode_height(float height)
```

Sets the Tall threshold, clamped to >= 0, and lays the view out again.

### mode

```cpp
TwoPaneMode mode() const
```

The mode the most recent [measure()](../tree/element.md#measure) pass picked; SinglePane before the first. No event reports a change. A caller that reacts to it reads it after layout, for example from its own [tick_override()](../tree/element.md#tick_override).

### for_each_child

```cpp
void for_each_child(ChildVisitor visit) const override
```

Only the panes the mode shows. A hidden pane takes no part in any walk over the tree, such as layout and rendering.

### measure_override

```cpp
Size measure_override(Size available, const MeasureContext& context) const override
```

The view itself is not focusable. [Tab](../controls/tabs.md#uitab) reaches into the shown panes.

### arrange_override

```cpp
void arrange_override(const Rect& final_rect, const ArrangeContext& context) override
```

Position children within the rect [arrange()](../tree/element.md#arrange) settled on (also in [bounds()](../tree/element.md#bounds), window DIPs). Default: nothing, for a leaf.

### render_override

```cpp
void render_override(Renderer& renderer, const RenderContext& context) const override
```

What the control draws, in layout coordinates; [render()](../tree/element.md#render) has already applied the visual layer. A container draws its children through their [render()](../tree/element.md#render), never their [render_override()](#render_override).

## Enumerations

### TwoPanePriority

```cpp
enum class TwoPanePriority
```

Which pane wins when the available space fits neither Wide nor Tall.

| Value | |
| --- | --- |
| `Pane1` | Show pane 1 alone (the default). |
| `Pane2` | Show pane 2 alone. |

### TwoPaneMode

```cpp
enum class TwoPaneMode
```

Which axis, if either, the two panes are split along, as mode() reports it. The order of the panes on that axis comes from [TwoPaneWideModeConfiguration](#twopanewidemodeconfiguration) or [TwoPaneTallModeConfiguration](#twopanetallmodeconfiguration), so mode() does not tell LeftRight from RightLeft.

| Value | |
| --- | --- |
| `SinglePane` | Only the pane_priority() pane is shown. |
| `Wide` | Both panes, side by side. |
| `Tall` | Both panes, one above the other. |

### TwoPaneWideModeConfiguration

```cpp
enum class TwoPaneWideModeConfiguration
```

How the panes are arranged once the width qualifies for Wide.

| Value | |
| --- | --- |
| `SinglePane` | Never split horizontally; fall through to the Tall test. |
| `LeftRight` | Pane 1 on the left (the default). |
| `RightLeft` | Pane 1 on the right. |

### TwoPaneTallModeConfiguration

```cpp
enum class TwoPaneTallModeConfiguration
```

How the panes are arranged once the height qualifies for Tall.

| Value | |
| --- | --- |
| `SinglePane` | Never stack; show a single pane instead. |
| `TopBottom` | Pane 1 on top (the default). |
| `BottomTop` | Pane 1 at the bottom. |
